{{Top}}
{{Otheruses|Cruiser}}
[[File:Dreadnaught-class_heavy_cruiser_AoRCR.png|thumb|right|250px|A [[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Dreadnaught''-class heavy cruiser]]]]
{{Quote|Looks like an Imperial cruiser. Our passengers must be hotter than I thought.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="Episode 4">{{Film|IV}}</ref>}}
'''Cruiser''' was a designation of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] class, which included wide variety of uses. The term '''[[Star Cruiser/Legends|star cruiser]]''' was often used as an alternate term.<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

Besides star-bound cruisers, there were also [[Cruiser (aquatic)|maritime cruisers]].<ref name="SWGB">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref>

==History==
[[File:DiamondClassCruiserSide-FFp62.png|thumb|left|A Commerce Guild ''Diamond''-class cruiser]]
Throughout naval history, it was used for some of the largest and most common [[Warship/Legends|warships]] in a given fleet, but alternate designations like '''[[Star Cruiser/Legends|Star Cruiser]]''' was also applied, like in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|navy]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]<ref name="SW:CL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> and the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="SOTG07">[[Starships of the Galaxy (Saga Edition)|''Starships of the Galaxy'', Saga Edition]]</ref> Ships that were designated with other names were also often referred to as cruisers.<ref name="SWEIII:ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref><ref name="SW:RC">''[[Star Wars: Republic Commando]]''</ref>

The cruiser designation for warships second only to [[Battleship/Legends|battleships]] was used to a certain extent by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]],<ref name="AOTC:ICS">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref> the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]<ref name="SWEIII:ROTS" /> and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] (as Star Cruisers).<ref name="SW:CL" /> The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] often used the Star Cruiser term to describe its heaviest [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] warships, which served as either cruisers or battleships.<ref name="TRAScB">''[[The Star Wars Trilogy Scrapbook: The Rebel Alliance]]''</ref>

In at least [[Anaxes War College System/Legends|one classification system]], cruisers could be divided into three categories: '''light''', '''medium''' and '''heavy'''. The light cruisers were at the lower end of the cruiser interval, around 350–400 meters, which likewise were sometimes interchangeable with [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]] under the [[Anaxes War College System/Legends|Anaxes War College System]],<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> medium cruisers between 400 and 500 meters, and heavy cruisers 600 meters and beyond. The latter group is also supplied under a completely separate class under the Anaxes War College System.<ref name="EGTW" /> The alternate designation of '''battle cruiser''' was also used for some ships in the same size brackets.<ref name="RASB">''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]''</ref>

With a variety of different ship classifications in use, some of these used the "cruiser" definition for diminutive patrol ships like the [[Guardian-class light cruiser|''Guardian''-class]] customs vessel.<ref name="TSIA">''[[Tapani Sector Instant Adventures]]''</ref><ref name="ROTS:ICS">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref>
